title: Config. Packages with Native AL XML Data Types
summary: RapidStart configuration package XML handling, mainly in codeunit Config. XML Exchange, now uses the native AL XML data types. The goal is to support cloud-ready development for partners. Related objects such as Config. Setup, Config. Import Table in Backgr and XML DOM Management were updated to match.
key_points: Config. XML Exchange reworked to use the native AL XML data types
Aims to make RapidStart configuration packages usable for cloud-ready partner development
Config. Setup, Config. Import Table in Backgr, Automation - Import RSPackage and XML DOM Management updated to match
RapidStart tests extended across many localization layers
